title.narrative: Charter for Change and Localisation of Humanitarian Aid

description.narrative: As a partnership organisation, CAFOD's Humanitarian Policy has for a long time highlighted the role that effective partnerships with local organisations play in humanitarian response and called for greater localisation of humanitarian aid, such as increased direct funding to national and local NGOs. These calls have been reflected in CAFOD's positions feeding into the World Humanitarian Summit. A recurring theme throughout the World Humanitarian Summit Consultations has been the need to better enable locally-led humanitarian response. To ensure that such calls are implemented CAFOD, in consultation with southern-based national actors and other INGOs has developed the Charter for Change Initiative to begin to make some of these changes within the INGO community. This initiative is supported by on-going research and consultations to identify practical ways through which the localisation of the humanitarian system can be realised.
